data.title: 千反田爱瑠 · 豪农深宅紫阳花径的雨后漫步·「你看，这一片是我亲手种下的呢」
data.description: 【千反田家大宅紫阳花回廊·雨后初晴】雨过天晴的日式庭院。爱瑠穿着素雅的浅紫无袖连衣裙，提着淡紫色裙摆漫步在水珠晶莹的蓝色与紫色绣球花海中。她侧头回眸伸手接住从花瓣滑落的雨滴，神情自豪又带着大小姐对这片土地的深沉眷恋。
data.location: 日式深宅庭院紫阳花石子径
data.action: 一手微提淡紫裙摆停在花径，另一手接住花瓣滑落的雨滴，回眸浅笑。
data.lighting: 雨洗碧空的明净天光与花瓣雨露折射
data.camera: medium full shot, hydrangeas, traditional garden, looking back
data.promptProse: Eru Chitanda walks through the lush stone garden of her family estate after a refreshing summer rain, surrounded by blooming bushes of deep blue and violet hydrangeas glistening with rain droplets. She wears a simple sleeveless lavender sundress, gently gathering the skirt with one hand as she pauses and turns her head back with a calm, proud smile. Her free palm catches one drop sliding from a nearby flower. Soft sunlight breaks through fading rain clouds, illuminating water droplets on her long black hair and porcelain shoulders. Medium full shot, fresh post-rain atmosphere, detailed Japanese estate garden background, solo 1girl, no extra people.
